<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE root [
  <!ELEMENT root (child)*>
  <!ELEMENT child (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY % ent "<!ELEMENT sub (#PCDATA)>">
  %ent;
  <!ENTITY base "Base Entity Text">
  <!ENTITY compound "&base; Extended">
]>
<?xml-stylesheet type="text/xsl" href="transform.xsl"?>
<root xmlns="http://example.org/ns/base" xmlns:sub="http://example.org/ns/sub">
  <!-- Primary comment block for testing comment handling in parser -->
  <child sub:id="1">
    <![CDATA[
      CDATA section containing <tags>, &entities; and -- comments -- inside.
    ]]>
  </child>
  <child>&compound;</child>
</root>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE inventory [
  <!ELEMENT inventory (item*)>
  <!ELEMENT item (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY itemEnt "Standard Item">
  <!NOTATION png SYSTEM "image/png">
  <!ENTITY logo SYSTEM "logo.png" NDATA png>
  <!ENTITY % extDtd SYSTEM "external.dtd">
  %extDtd;
]>
<?xml-process-instruction target="validation" status="active"?>
<inventory xmlns="urn:inventory:schema" xmlns:inv="urn:inventory:custom">
  <!-- Inventory header comment -->
  <inv:item code="A001">
    <![CDATA[
      Special item notes with <brackets> & ampersands.
    ]]>
  </inv:item>
  <item>&itemEnt;</item>
</inventory>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE catalog [
  <!ELEMENT catalog (book*)>
  <!ELEMENT book (title, author)>
  <!ELEMENT title (#PCDATA)>
  <!ELEMENT author (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY pub "O'Reilly Media">
  <!ENTITY ref "Reference Manual">
  <!ENTITY % param "<!ENTITY nested 'Nested &pub;'>">
  %param;
]>
<?xml-stylesheet href="catalog.css" type="text/css"?>
<catalog xmlns="http://schemas.example.com/catalog" xmlns:cat="http://schemas.example.com/catalog/ext">
  <!-- Comment: Catalog containing various book definitions -->
  <book cat:format="hardcover">
    <title>XML &ref;</title>
    <author>
      <![CDATA[
        Author name with <markup> emulation and entities &pub;
      ]]>
    </author>
  </book>
</catalog>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE archive [
  <!ELEMENT archive (record*)>
  <!ELEMENT record (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY rec1 "Record Type Alpha">
  <!ENTITY rec2 "Record Type Beta">
  <!ENTITY combined "&rec1; & &rec2;">
  <!NOTATION pdf SYSTEM "application/pdf">
  <!ENTITY doc SYSTEM "spec.pdf" NDATA pdf>
]>
<?xml-model href="schema.rng" type="application/xml-relax-ng"?>
<archive xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2005/Atom" xmlns:atom="http://www.w3.org/2005/Atom">
  <!-- Archival data container root comment -->
  <atom:record id="rec-001">
    <![CDATA[
      <atom:entry>
        <title>Embedded Atom Entry in CDATA</title>
      </atom:entry>
    ]]>
  </atom:record>
  <record>&combined;</record>
</archive>
```

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE configuration [
  <!ELEMENT configuration (setting*)>
  <!ELEMENT setting (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY defaultTimeout "30">
  <!ENTITY maxRetries "5">
  <!ENTITY % sysEnt "<!ENTITY fullConfig 'Timeout: &defaultTimeout;, Retries: &maxRetries;'>">
  %sysEnt;
]>
<?xml-hip loglevel="debug"?>
<configuration xmlns="http://example.com/config" xmlns:cfg="http://example.com/config/meta">
  <!-- Configuration properties comment block -->
  <setting cfg:scope="global">
    <![CDATA[
      Raw configuration block:
      [Server]
      host=localhost
      port=8080
    ]]>
  </setting>
  <setting>&fullConfig;</setting>
</configuration>
```

<!DOCTYPE project [
  <!ELEMENT project (module*)>
  <!ELEMENT module (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY modA "Core Module">
  <!ENTITY modB "Extension Module">
  <!NOTATION jar SYSTEM "application/java-archive">
  <!ENTITY lib SYSTEM "library.jar" NDATA jar>
  <!ENTITY % macroDef "<!ENTITY expansion 'Expanded via Parameter Entity'>">
  %macroDef;
]>
<?xml-check strict="true"?>
<project xmlns="http://maven.apache.org/POM/4.0.0" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance">
  <!-- Build project descriptor comment -->
  <module xsi:type="string">
    <![CDATA[
      Module source code reference: <dependency>
        <groupId>com.example</groupId>
        <artifactId>core</artifactId>
      </dependency>
    ]]>
  </module>
  <module>&expansion;</module>
</project>
```

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE response [
  <!ELEMENT response (payload*)>
  <!ELEMENT payload (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY statusOk "Operation Successful">
  <!ENTITY statusErr "Operation Failed">
  <!ENTITY report "Status: &statusOk;">
  <!ENTITY % shared "<!ENTITY note 'Shared system note'>">
  %shared;
]>
<?xml-server mode="production" timeout="500"?>
<response xmlns="http://rest.example.com/schema" xmlns:res="http://rest.example.com/schema/response">
  <!-- Response wrapper element comment -->
  <res:payload code="200">
    <![CDATA[
      JSON-like or custom payload inside CDATA:
      {
        "code": 200,
        "message": "&statusOk;"
      }
    ]]>
  </res:payload>
  <payload>&report; | ¬e;</payload>
</response>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE metrics [
  <!ELEMENT metrics (metric*)>
  <!ELEMENT metric (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY m1 "CPU Usage">
  <!ENTITY m2 "Memory Utilization">
  <!ENTITY m3 "&m1; and &m2;">
  <!NOTATION csv SYSTEM "text/csv">
  <!ENTITY dataFile SYSTEM "stats.csv" NDATA csv>
]>
<?xml-metrics refresh="60" target="dashboard"?>
<metrics xmlns="http://metrics.example.org/ns" xmlns:m="http://metrics.example.org/ns/meta">
  <!-- Metrics collector start comment -->
  <m:metric unit="percent">
    <![CDATA[
      Raw telemetry dump:
      cpu_user=12.4
      cpu_sys=3.1
      mem_free=4096MB
    ]]>
  </m:metric>
  <metric>&m3;</metric>
</metrics>
```

      - Risk assessment
    ]]>

  <phase>&timeline; : &milestone;</phase>
</roadmap>

<!DOCTYPE suite [
  <!ELEMENT suite (test*)>
  <!ELEMENT test (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY test1 "Unit Test Suite">
  <!ENTITY test2 "Integration Test Suite">
  <!ENTITY allTests "&test1; & &test2;">
  <!NOTATION exe SYSTEM "application/x-msdownload">
  <!ENTITY runner SYSTEM "testrunner.exe" NDATA exe>
  <!ENTITY % testMacro "<!ENTITY summary 'All suites loaded successfully'>">
  %testMacro;
]>
<?xml-test-runner framework="junit" version="5.8"?>
<suite xmlns="http://junit.org/schema/suite" xmlns:t="http://junit.org/schema/test">
  <!-- Test suite initialization comment -->
  <t:test id="T-001">
    <![CDATA[
      Test execution log:
      [INFO] Running TestSuite
      [INFO] Tests passed: 42, Failed: 0
    ]]>
  </t:test>
  <test>&allTests; - &summary;</test>
</suite>
